selection.selectionRule: five deep-read public development members with distinct mechanical structures; no held-out or Q1 material

interpretation.sourceAuthority: SKILL.md rules, declared resources and source-program files are the authority for what a workflow requires
interpretation.traceAuthority: trace and report locators record what was actually observed and never fill an absent source or execution field
interpretation.instructionVsTrace: A fixed step is a source-backed workflow obligation; an observed step is a tool call or produced file bound to a located trace. Missing or partial traces remain unknown.
interpretation.claimBoundary: This is a pattern-to-code planning and evidence index. It does not claim that the current engine can implement every listed branch or that any skill-wide quality/effect result is positive.

trace.note: The corpus review binds the source body but no actual run record for this member. No command, file write or quality result is inferred.
